name: How much does low-maintenance landscaping typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does low-maintenance landscaping typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of low-maintenance landscaping varies significantly based on factors like yard size, material choices, and design complexity. Basic installations, such as gravel and a few desert-adapted plants, can start lower, while elaborate designs with artificial turf, intricate hardscaping, or advanced irrigation systems will be higher. Artificial turf, for instance, has a higher upfront cost but saves on water and maintenance long-term. Consulting with a local contractor will provide a more accurate estimate tailored to your specific project and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on yard size, materials, and design. Artificial turf has a higher upfront cost but saves money long-term.
